summary: Verified 4 mobile bug fixes on /eventos and /nosotros pages at 320px and 390px viewports, plus desktop regression at 1920x800. All 4 reported bugs appear resolved: (1) chevron/title overlap on Eventos, (2) tab label word-wrap on Eventos, (3) category-box overlap on Eventos (both FESTIVAL and PREMIER), (4) history section mobile empty gap on Nosotros. Desktop layouts (Eventos, Nosotros) still load correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: browser console shows two 401s per page load ('Failed to load resource'). Likely an auth-scoped API call being fired on public pages (e.g., /api/auth/me or similar). Not affecting UX but pollutes console; main agent should gate the request behind an auth-check.

Non-blocking: /eventos hero region on desktop 1920x800 renders as a nearly empty band (header + a large blank area) — verify whether this is intentional (background hero) or a missing background image.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Eventos mobile @320px: FESTIVAL tab shows 1 category (festival-cat-0) at x=16 y=926 w=91 h=49, no overlaps. PREMIER shows 10 boxes (5 pares + 5 impares) stacked vertically in groups (pares y=902-1008, impares y=1093-1199). Tab buttons render 'festival'/'premier' on single line with date subtitle on next line (whitespace:normal but word itself not split). Chevron stacks flank the title-word without overlapping (title-word at x=76 width=168 within 320px viewport). Nosotros mobile @390px: after clicking history-next-btn, photo banner bottom=398px, timeline-bar top=524px → 126px vertical space that contains the prev/next nav arrows (functional, not empty). Desktop 1920x800: both pages load with proper navbar and full-width layout.
